name: linkguard
description: GitHub Action that checks outbound links in static sites and finds Wayback Machine snapshots for dead ones.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --legal-comments=none --banner:js="import { createRequire as __lgCreateRequire } from 'module'; const require = __lgCreateRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
